mapper.select: SELECT * FROM alarm_rule WHERE del_flag = '0' AND enable_status = '1'

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alarm_rule WHERE del_flag = '0' AND enable_status = '1') as "enableRuleCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alarm_record WHERE recover_status = '0') as "unrecoveredAlarmCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alarm_record WHERE trigger_time >= CURRENT_DATE) as "todayAlarmTotal", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alarm_record WHERE trigger_time >= CURRENT_DATE AND alarm_level = 1) as "todayInfoCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alarm_record WHERE trigger_time >= CURRENT_DATE AND alarm_level = 2) as "todayAlarmCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alarm_record WHERE trigger_time >= CURRENT_DATE AND alarm_level = 3) as "todaySeverityCount"

SELECT rule_id, rule_name, metric_key, metric_name, compare_type, threshold, unit, alarm_level, scope_type, scope_instance_id, enable_status, del_flag, created_time, updated_time FROM alarm_rule WHERE enable_status = 1 AND del_flag = 0

SELECT rule_id, rule_name, metric_key, metric_name, compare_type, threshold, unit, alarm_level, scope_type, scope_instance_id, enable_status, del_flag, created_time, updated_time FROM alarm_rule WHERE enable_status = 1 AND del_flag = 0 AND ( scope_type = '1' OR CONCAT(',', REPLACE(scope_instance_id, ' ', ''), ',') LIKE CONCAT('%,', #{instanceId}, ',%') )

SELECT rule_id, rule_name, metric_key, metric_name, compare_type, threshold, unit, alarm_level, scope_type, scope_instance_id, enable_status, del_flag, created_time, updated_time FROM alarm_rule WHERE enable_status = 1 AND del_flag = 0 AND metric_key = #{metricKey}
